decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two storey side extension and single storey rear extension hereby permittedwill preserve and enhance the character of the Conservation Area and will not result in a significant adverse affect upon the living conditions of adjoining residential occupiers. This is in accordance with policies ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough Of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003; and the Hounslow Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am  to 5pm  on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 12pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, part two storey/part first floor side extension to existing house.
